steps.code:
# Get all liked songs (all pages)
liked_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for song in page:
        liked_song_ids.add(song['song_id'])
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Liked song IDs:", liked_song_ids)
steps.raw_response:
# Get all liked songs (all pages)
liked_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for song in page:
        liked_song_ids.add(song['song_id'])
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Liked song IDs:", liked_song_ids)

steps.code:
# Now we'll keep going to the next song until we find a liked one
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
while current['song_id'] not in liked_song_ids:
    # Go to next song
    result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Next song result:", result)
    # Get the new current song
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Current song now:", current['song_id'], current['title'])

# Found a liked song
print("Found liked song:", current['song_id'], current['title'])
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=current['title'])
